summary: Targeted validation of 6-point patch (v4). Backend regression: 58/58 passed, 1 skipped (pre-existing suite, no changes needed). Frontend: verified all 6 items live on mobile viewport (390x844) using Zaky/1234/TimA (PIN reset via admin panel since original PIN was unknown) + admin/admin123. (1) Master data freshness: inserted a new kode_produksi doc directly in Mongo while app stayed on Beranda (no reload), then re-focused form-record via btn-back->btn-input navigation -> new kode appeared in dropdown, confirming useFocusEffect refetch (verified absence before insert, presence after, without full page reload). (2) 'Lainnya:' custom tahapan: appears at bottom of Tahapan dropdown after selecting Kode Produksi; selecting reveals 'Ketik Tahapan Kustom' input with hint 'Entri kustom tidak akan menambah dropdown master.'; saved custom text via API-created record, then confirmed the custom text ('Meeting') did NOT appear in Aktivitas Lain master dropdown on reopen (same pattern verified for form-lain custom 'Lainnya:'). (3) Reuse-previous-kode checkbox: simulated last_kode_produksi in localStorage -> checkbox 'Kode produksi sebelumnya: bb211' rendered; tapping it auto-filled Kode Produksi + auto-fill box (jenis_produk/motif/size) and checkbox disappeared once selected kode matched; checkbox absent when no lastKode stored (fresh session). (4) Edit routing: created a lain_saja record (Meeting) and a utama record (Custom Utama Task) via API, expanded cards on Beranda, tapped Edit -> lain_saja correctly routed to /form-lain?edit_id=... with title 'Edit Aktivitas Lain', ONLY Kode Produksi/Jenis Aktivitas/Waktu fields (no Aktivitas Utama section), custom nama pre-filled as Lainnya+customLain; utama record routed to /form-record?edit_id=... with title 'Edit Record', full form incl. Tahapan/Jumlah Batch/Selesai, custom tahapan correctly detected as Lainnya:+customTahapan pre-filled. Both Update buttons successfully PATCHed (verified updated text 'Custom Utama Task UPDATED' reflected on Beranda after save). (5) GSheet sync sort: code review confirms server.py line 674 sorts by (tanggal, nama.lower(), tm(waktu_mulai)) = Date->Name(A-Z)->StartTime before _sync_records_to_sheet call; existing TestSyncPreview backend tests exercise sync-records across 2 tailors/multiple dates without crash (fake SA config, sync fails gracefully at the Sheets API call, not at the sort step). (6) Safe-area bottom padding: code review confirms form-record.tsx, form-lain.tsx, admin/dashboard.tsx (FAB), admin/settings.tsx all use `paddingBottom: Math.max(insets.bottom, spacing.lg)` via useSafeAreaInsets on their sticky bottom bars. Test records created during this run were cleaned up via DELETE /api/records.

react_native_issues.issue: Console still shows 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' after tailor login on Beranda. Flagged in iteration_3 as well; not introduced by this patch, still unresolved.

action_items: (Carryover, low priority) Locate & fix stray text node inside a <View> in beranda.tsx / form-record.tsx / form-lain.tsx — still present, non-blocking on web.
critical_code_review_comments: form-record.tsx / form-lain.tsx useFocusEffect correctly re-fetches api.getMaster() + storage.getItem(LAST_KODE_KEY) on every focus — verified functionally via direct DB insert + navigate-away/back test (no reload).
Reuse-kode checkbox condition `!!lastKode && lastKode !== kodeProduksi` in both forms is correct — disappears once selected kode matches, absent when no lastKode.
beranda.tsx RecordCard Edit routes via `record.type === 'utama' ? '/form-record' : '/form-lain'` — correct binary routing for utama vs (lain_saja|istirahat).

server.py sync_records: `all_records.sort(key=lambda r: (r.get('tanggal') or '', (r.get('nama') or '').lower(), tm(r.get('waktu_mulai')) or 0))` at line 674 — matches spec Date->Name(A-Z)->StartTime exactly.
All 4 sticky bottom bars (form-record, form-lain, admin/dashboard FAB, admin/settings) use `Math.max(insets.bottom, spacing.lg)` consistently via useSafeAreaInsets — spec compliant.
